dialogues.speaker: Vlad
dialogues.text: The Lantern Rite fireworks are ever so beautiful. I'd love to watch them again with her before the boat arrives...

dialogues.speaker: Vlad
dialogues.text: Uh, sorry. Were you talking to me?

dialogues.speaker: Vlad
dialogues.text: Sorry, it's been a while since someone has spoken to me, you literally caught me off guard.

dialogues.speaker: Vlad
dialogues.text: But... I don't really wish to actively socialize with the people here.

dialogues.speaker: Vlad
dialogues.text: Hmm? Are you talking to me?

dialogues.speaker: Vlad
dialogues.text: Sorry, it's been a while since someone has spoken to me, you literally caught me off guard.

dialogues.speaker: Vlad
dialogues.text: But... I don't really wish to actively socialize with the people here.

dialogues.speaker: Vlad
dialogues.text: Who are you?

dialogues.speaker: Vlad
dialogues.text: I am the guard here.

dialogues.speaker: Vlad
dialogues.text: This is the Northland Bank, which was opened in Liyue by Snezhnaya. It's also the only non-local bank here in Liyue.

dialogues.speaker: Vlad
dialogues.text: That's about all I know. If you would like to know more, you could talk to the manager.

dialogues.speaker: Vlad
dialogues.text: You don't want to socialize with others?

dialogues.speaker: Vlad
dialogues.text: Well, I did try to fit in at first, but eventually I realized it was no use and just gave up.

dialogues.speaker: Vlad
dialogues.text: Even though I've met a lot of people here, in the end, I couldn't help but still feel a certain distance between myself and them. I was never included as a part of the group.

dialogues.speaker: Vlad
dialogues.text: And socializing with them is exhausting. At this point, I've lost all interest in trying...

dialogues.speaker: Vlad
dialogues.text: Perhaps there are just too many cultural differences.

dialogues.speaker: Vlad
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Vlad
dialogues.text: If you don't have any urgent matters, then you best be on your way. Idle chatter is not part of my duties here.

dialogues.speaker: Vlad
dialogues.text: Hmm? Are you talking to me?

dialogues.speaker: Vlad
dialogues.text: Sorry, I was just reminiscing about my hometown.

dialogues.speaker: Vlad
dialogues.text: What are you doing?

dialogues.speaker: Vlad
dialogues.text: I'm waiting for a boat, a boat that will come at an unknown time, a boat that will take me home.

dialogues.speaker: Vlad
dialogues.text: My name is Vlad. I was transferred from my home country of Snezhnaya to come work here in Liyue.

dialogues.speaker: Vlad
dialogues.text: I've already been in this city for some time now, but clearly it's impossible for me to fit in here. So I've sent an application to headquarters to be transferred back home, but I don't know when the boat will arrive.

dialogues.speaker: Vlad
dialogues.text: Even though I live here, I don't interact at all with the people of this city, except for just one person.

dialogues.speaker: Vlad
dialogues.text: Tell me about that person.

dialogues.speaker: Vlad
dialogues.text: She's also a guard at the Northland Bank like me, except I have the day shift, and she has the night shift.

dialogues.speaker: Vlad
dialogues.text: It's as if I'm the sun, and she's the moon. Even though we're aware of one another's existence, our paths will never meet. I guess that's just how it's meant to be.

dialogues.speaker: Vlad
dialogues.text: Then one day out of the blue, she left a letter for me right where we change the guard. We've been writing each other as pen pals ever since.

dialogues.speaker: Vlad
dialogues.text: Although I can't wait for the boat to arrive, reading her letters is the only thing that makes my heart feel at ease.

dialogues.speaker: Vlad
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Vlad
dialogues.text: Goodbye. May the comfort of home never leave your side.
